metrics.name: Template compiles
metrics.construct: Whether the exercise template builds in the target toolchain
metrics.denominator: candidates whose build backend returned a result
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the metric does not apply to the case; infra_failure never yields a value; a build agent failure is infra_failure, never false
metrics.implementation: tools/tier1-deterministic/java-oracle, via the configured build backend

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: under the LocalCI profile the system under test computes its own build result; no build revision attestation exists, so runs are not comparable across deployment changes

metrics.name: Solution compiles
metrics.construct: Whether the reference solution builds in the target toolchain
metrics.denominator: candidates whose build backend returned a result
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the metric does not apply to the case; infra_failure never yields a value; a build agent failure is infra_failure, never false
metrics.implementation: tools/tier1-deterministic/java-oracle, via the configured build backend

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: same independence and attestation limits as build.template_compiles

metrics.name: Test suite executable
metrics.construct: Whether the generated test suite ran to completion against both submissions without a harness error
metrics.denominator: candidates whose build backend returned a result
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the metric does not apply to the case; infra_failure never yields a value; a queue or agent timeout is infra_failure, never false

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: a compiled build reporting no test cases is recorded as not executed rather than as a pass rate over an empty suite

metrics.name: Declared test cases
metrics.construct: Number of test cases the generated suite declares
metrics.denominator: one value per candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the metric does not apply to the case; infra_failure never yields a value

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: counts what the build backend reported, which may merge parameterised cases

metrics.name: Solution pass rate
metrics.construct: Share of the generated tests the reference solution passes
metrics.denominator: declared test cases for that candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the exercise declares no test cases; never imputed to zero

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: a gate input, not a gate: only oracle.satisfied decides acceptance

metrics.name: Template pass rate
metrics.construct: Share of the generated tests the template already passes
metrics.denominator: declared test cases for that candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the exercise declares no test cases; never imputed to zero

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: a gate input, not a gate; a template passing any test means there is nothing left for a student to do

metrics.name: Oracle gate satisfied
metrics.construct: Whether the reference solution passes every generated test and the template passes none
metrics.denominator: candidates with a quality outcome
metrics.status_mapping: the only metric that decides this evaluator's strict_success; a build or agent failure is infra_failure with no value
metrics.evidence: build backend results for both submissions

validation.method: contract tested against the synthetic fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures; LocalCI deployment behavior is not verified here

metrics.limitations: under the LocalCI profile the system under test computes the acceptance gate; host profiles execute candidate code without isolation; formal use requires an isolated backend

metrics.name: Statement coverage
metrics.construct: Share of solution statements the generated tests execute
metrics.denominator: candidates for which the backend reported coverage
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the backend reports no coverage
metrics.implementation: tools/tier1-deterministic/java-oracle, from the backend's JaCoCo report

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: never an acceptance gate: folding a coverage threshold into acceptance would collapse the threshold hypotheses and the primary success rate into one number

metrics.name: Branch coverage
metrics.construct: Share of solution branches the generated tests execute
metrics.denominator: candidates for which the backend reported branch coverage
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the backend reports no branch coverage
metrics.implementation: tools/tier1-deterministic/java-oracle, from the backend's JaCoCo report

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: reported by the Maven profile from JaCoCo; not_applicable under the localci profile, which Artemis exposes no coverage to, and under the uninstrumented gradle profile; never an acceptance gate

metrics.name: Mutation score
metrics.construct: Share of injected faults the generated tests detect
metrics.denominator: generated mutants for that candidate
metrics.status_mapping: always not_applicable in this iteration

validation.method: not yet implemented

metrics.limitations: mutants are sealed suite assets, so this metric requires an isolated backend that can combine them with the candidate

metrics.name: Required constructs present
metrics.construct: Whether the solution uses every construct the case's specification requires
metrics.denominator: candidates whose case has a construct specification
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable for every case without a construct specification

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures; corpus specifications require independent second coding before validation

metrics.limitations: syntactic presence only, from a lexer and brace-level structure recovery rather than a Java parser; a construct that appears but never executes still counts. Ambiguous tokens are resolved to miss a construct rather than invent one: `?` is a ternary only outside a generic argument list (not a `List<?>` wildcard), `extends`/`implements` are inheritance only outside a type bound (not `<T extends N>`), `->` is a lambda unless it is a switch rule, and a stream requires the java.util.stream package, Collectors or a .stream()/.parallelStream() pipeline. Recursion is name-based and cannot separate a same-named overload.

metrics.name: Forbidden constructs absent
metrics.construct: Whether the solution avoids every construct the case's specification forbids
metrics.denominator: candidates whose case has a construct specification
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable for every case without a specification

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: same syntactic-presence limits as concept.required_constructs_present

metrics.name: First missing construct
metrics.construct: Which required construct the solution does not use
metrics.denominator: candidates whose case has a construct specification
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable without a specification; 'none' when nothing is missing

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: reports the first missing construct in vocabulary order; concept.missing_count carries the total and the score message lists them all for a restricted reader

metrics.name: Missing construct count
metrics.construct: How many required constructs the solution does not use
metrics.denominator: candidates whose case has a construct specification
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable without a specification

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: bounded above by the size of the case's required list

metrics.name: Forbidden construct count
metrics.construct: How many forbidden constructs the solution uses
metrics.denominator: candidates whose case has a construct specification
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable without a specification

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: bounded above by the size of the case's forbidden list

metrics.name: Maximum cyclomatic complexity
metrics.construct: The highest McCabe cyclomatic complexity of any solution method
metrics.denominator: one value per candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the solution declares no method body

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: counts if, for, while, do, case, catch, &&, || and the ternary; else and default are not counted; measured without a spec, so only the bound needs ground truth

metrics.name: Maximum cognitive complexity
metrics.construct: The highest Campbell cognitive complexity of any solution method
metrics.denominator: one value per candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the solution declares no method body

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: nesting is tracked from the braces of nesting structures, so a construct whose nesting the structure recovery cannot see is undercounted

metrics.name: Complexity within bounds
metrics.construct: Whether every solution method stays inside the complexity bounds the case declares
metrics.denominator: candidates whose case declares a complexity bound
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable without a specification or without a declared bound

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: the bound is an authored judgement per case and requires independent review before validation

metrics.name: Cross-artifact residuals
metrics.construct: Number of disagreements between the problem statement and the generated artifacts
metrics.denominator: one value per candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the metric does not apply to the case; infra_failure never yields a value

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: the sum of four independently reported classes; a total on its own is not actionable and should be read with the breakdown

metrics.name: Ungrounded statement identifiers
metrics.construct: Identifiers the statement names in a code span that appear in no generated artifact
metrics.denominator: one value per candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the metric does not apply to the case; infra_failure never yields a value

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: only identifiers inside Markdown code spans are checked; a statement that names a class in prose produces no residual. Spans that read as prose, variables a worked example declares, member chains through a JDK type such as String.endsWith, and the package parts of fully qualified JDK names are not checked, so misnaming one of these produces no residual. A JDK type named on its own is checked. A span with three or more lowercase segments that starts like a declared package is compared as a whole against the declared packages, and the type it ends in is checked as a name; a Type.member reference is checked by its member name only, because the analyser has no inheritance information

metrics.name: Unmentioned public API
metrics.construct: Types the solution declares that the statement never names
metrics.denominator: one value per candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the metric does not apply to the case; infra_failure never yields a value

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: a weak signal: a legitimate helper type produces a residual, so it is reported but does not fail consistency.satisfied

metrics.name: Contradicted constructs
metrics.construct: Constructs the statement requires or forbids that the solution does the opposite of
metrics.denominator: one value per candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the metric does not apply to the case; infra_failure never yields a value

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: phrase matching is English and Artemis-flavoured; a statement in another language falls through and produces no residual, which under-reports rather than over-reports

metrics.name: Unsupported statement values
metrics.construct: Integer values the statement specifies that no generated test asserts
metrics.denominator: one value per candidate
metrics.status_mapping: not_applicable when the metric does not apply to the case; infra_failure never yields a value

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: distinct values, not distinct mentions; a value a test computes rather than writes literally produces a false residual

metrics.name: Cross-artifact consistency satisfied
metrics.construct: Whether the statement and the generated artifacts describe the same exercise
metrics.denominator: candidates with a quality outcome
metrics.status_mapping: gates this evaluator's strict_success only; never the benchmark's. True when every residual class except unmentioned_public_api is empty

validation.method: contract tested against the hand-authored fixture corpus in tools/kit/fixtures

metrics.limitations: an exercise can be perfectly buildable and still describe something other than what it tests; that is the point of reporting this separately from the oracle gate
